# PCRE2 upstream test inputs

The `testinput*` files are copied from:

`https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2/tree/main/testdata`

They match the unreleased PCRE2 10.48 source version in `c_src/` and are used
only as differential input records. PCRE2 is distributed under the BSD
3-Clause license; see the upstream project for its license text.
